recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Handle future DiagnosticReport/Observation grouping or component modeling changes under their own OO Jira decisions rather than reopening FHIR-16064.
issue_request: FHIR-16064 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 OO change request asking whether DiagnosticReport.result allowed Observation.component content, because the old element definition described simple and grouping Observations without making component use clear. The approved resolution was to remove the more descriptive element-definition prose and simply state "Observations that are part of this diagnostic report" with an inline link to Observation.
initial_application: Commit 468774c1b07865f7af97bf1643874d2e37067aaf included GF#16064 and removed the old DiagnosticReport.result definition text about simple name/value pairs and grouping observations from the DiagnosticReport spreadsheet. The current XML source was later rebuilt in commit 33b409a4b6d while preserving the simplified linked definition.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml currently defines DiagnosticReport.result as Reference(Observation) with the simplified Observation-linked definition. Observation.component remains defined in the Observation resource. Broader DiagnosticReport/Observation grouping narrative and later R6 grouping trackers do not reverse FHIR-16064 or require component-specific text on DiagnosticReport.result.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current element definition already implements the FHIR-16064 resolution, and adding redundant component guidance to DiagnosticReport.result would reintroduce detail that the work group chose to leave to Observation.

related_jiras.note: Earlier OO guidance on DiagnosticReport/Observation panels and batteries explains why separate narrative grouping guidance exists outside the FHIR-16064 element-definition cleanup.
Later R6 grouping proposal was resolved no-change and did not require changing DiagnosticReport.result for this issue.
Later R6 request to add List as a DiagnosticReport.result grouping choice was resolved no-change, supporting that this audit should not broaden the element type.
Later R6 grouping proposal was resolved no-change and left grouping changes to their own Jira path.
